description: A small-molecule compound increases expression of a human gene in a statistically significant consensus of LINCS L1000 / Connectivity Map perturbation signatures.

common_properties.name: z_score
common_properties.description: Signed Stouffer consensus z-score for the compound–gene pair; positive values indicate increased expression.
common_properties.notes: Carries magnitude; sign is consistent with the edge's up/down type

common_properties.name: p_value
common_properties.description: Bonferroni-corrected two-tailed normal p-value, corrected separately for each compound and target-gene tier. Edges meet a significance threshold of 0.05.

common_properties.name: tier
common_properties.description: Target-gene evidence tier: landmark genes are directly measured; BING genes here are well-inferred genes excluding landmarks.

common_properties.name: n_signatures
common_properties.description: Number of pooled expression signatures combined into the compound's consensus profile, indicating supporting evidence.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Source attribution for the compound perturbation relationship.
common_properties.notes: Single-element list under this source; list, never scalar

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the edge was created or last updated.

source_contributions.scope: Small-molecule treatments (trt_cp) from GEO series GSE92742 and GSE70138. Targets include directly measured landmark genes and well-inferred non-landmark BING genes; poorly inferred non-BING genes are excluded. Coverage is restricted to compounds and genes represented in SPOKE. Compounds lacking chemical identifiers, including compounds exclusive to GSE70138, are excluded. No touchstone restriction is applied.
source_contributions.description: Signatures for the same compound are pooled across preparations, cell lines, doses, times, and both GEO series into a consensus differential-expression profile using correlation-weighted Stouffer integration. Significance is assessed separately for landmark and non-landmark BING targets. All significant landmark targets are retained; non-landmark BING targets are limited to the top 1,000 by significance per compound. Positive consensus z-scores produce these upregulation relationships.
